description: About the Team Our Inference team brings OpenAI’s most capable research and technology to the world through our products. Explore techniques such as quantization to improve inference efficiency while preserving model quality. Build benchmarks and tools to measure performance, validate correctness, and guide optimization work. Partner with researchers and engineers to support new model architectures and bring performance improvements into production.
